newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 9.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp plans to entrust production of its Lancer passenger car at its unit in India to an alliance of General Motors Corp and Hindustan Motors Ltd in early 1998. It will be the first time GM and Mitsubishi have tied up in production. The three car makers are expected to sign the deal as early as December.

Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd is expected to have increased its parent current profit by 4.5 times from a year ago to more than ten billion yen for the half-year to September 30, helped by strong car sales and weaker yen.

Sakura Bank Ltd plans to start full operation of an unmanned satellite office at IBM Japan's Hakozaki branch in Tokyo from next year. It will be the first time the city bank has opened such a facility.

Matsushita Battery Industrial Co Ltd plans to start producing solar-powered electricity generation systems by the business year starting April 1, 2000. The system will be based on high energy conversion solar cells, which have a 15.2 percent energy conversion efficiency rate.
